streakStep.cel: cel.bind(n, acc.last == null ? 1 : nextStreak(acc.streak, daysBetween(acc.last, day)), {'streak': n, 'best': acc.best > n ? acc.best : n, 'last': day})

streakFromHistory.cel: cel.bind(acc, fold(checkins.filter(d, d <= today), {'streak': 0, 'best': storedBest, 'last': null}, 'streakStep'), {'streak': acc.last == null || daysBetween(acc.last, today) > 1 ? 0 : acc.streak, 'best': acc.best, 'risk': acc.last != null && daysBetween(acc.last, today) == 1})

dayStatus.cel: !(d in days) || days[d].size() == 0 ? 'none' : days[d].all(e, e.done) ? 'complete' : d == today ? 'active' : days[d].exists(e, e.done) ? 'partial' : 'incomplete'
